# INSITOOLS

> INSITOOLS supplies portable on-site machining, welding, valve repair, pipe cutting and hydraulic equipment, with on-site machining services and equipment rental. Headquartered in Singapore (Assurich Industries Pte Ltd) with service teams in Thailand and across ASEAN, backed by 42+ years of industrial equipment distribution and after-sales service.

Contact: sales@assurich.com · +65 6459 1069 · WhatsApp +6598183419 · 9 Tagore Lane #04-28, 9@Tagore, Singapore 787472

## Boring Machines
Portable line boring machines restore worn bores, pin housings and bearing seats in-situ, so heavy equipment, vessels and plant can be repaired where they stand instead of being dismantled and shipped to a workshop.
- [BB40 Portable Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb40-portable-boring-machine.html)
- [BB50 Portable Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb50-portable-boring-machine.html)
- [BB60 Portable Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb60-portable-boring-machine.html)
- [BB80 Portable Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb80-portable-boring-machine.html)
- [BB100 Heavy Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb100-heavy-boring-machine.html)
- [BB120 Heavy Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb120-heavy-boring-machine.html)
- [BB160 Ultra Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb160-ultra-boring-machine.html)
- [BB200 Industrial Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb200-industrial-boring-machine.html)
- [PB 800BL/90 Portable Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/pb-800bl-90-portable-boring-machine.html)
- [On-Site Lathe Machine](https://insitools.com/product/on-site-lathe-machine.html)

## Milling Machines
Portable and gantry milling machines bolt directly onto large components to machine flat surfaces, keyways and mounting pads on site with workshop-level accuracy.
- [ILMD1000 Gantry Milling Machine](https://insitools.com/product/ilmd1000-gantry-milling-machine.html)
- [ILMD2000 Gantry Milling Machine](https://insitools.com/product/ilmd2000-gantry-milling-machine.html)
- [ILMD3000 Gantry Milling Machine](https://insitools.com/product/ilmd3000-gantry-milling-machine.html)
- [ILMD4000 Gantry Milling Machine](https://insitools.com/product/ilmd4000-gantry-milling-machine.html)
- [ILMD5000 Gantry Milling Machine](https://insitools.com/product/ilmd5000-gantry-milling-machine.html)

## Bore Welders
Automatic bore welders build up worn bores and faces with a controlled weld overlay, so the bore can then be line-bored back to its original size on site.
- [BW350 Automated Bore Welder](https://insitools.com/product/bw350-automated-bore-welder.html)
- [ABW 350/360 Bore Welder](https://insitools.com/product/abw-350-360-bore-welder.html)
- [BW3000 Automated Welder](https://insitools.com/product/bw3000-automated-welder.html)
- [BW1000 Heavy Bore Welder](https://insitools.com/product/bw1000-heavy-bore-welder.html)

## Valve Solution
In-situ valve grinding and lapping machines restore the sealing seats of gate, globe and safety valves without removing the valve from the line.
- [In-Situ Gate Valve Lapping Machine](https://insitools.com/product/in-situ-gate-valve-lapping-machine.html)
- [IS57928 In-Situ Globe Valve (Flat Seat) Grinding & Lapping Machine](https://insitools.com/product/is57928-in-situ-globe-valve-flat-seat-grinding-lapping-machine.html)
- [Valve Lapping/Grinding Machines](https://insitools.com/product/valve-lapping-grinding-machines.html)
- [VT400W Enclosed Wedge Lapping Cabinet](https://insitools.com/product/vt400w-enclosed-wedge-lapping-cabinet.html)

## Pipe Cutting
Split-frame and clamshell pipe cutters cold-cut and bevel in-line pipe for weld preparation, without heat, sparks or the need to remove the pipe.
- [Portable Plate Bevel Machine](https://insitools.com/product/portable-plate-bevel-machine.html)
- [Pipe Cold Cutting & Bevel Machine](https://insitools.com/product/pipe-cold-cutting-bevel-machine.html)
- [Clamshell Pipe Cutters](https://insitools.com/product/clamshell-pipe-cutters.html)
- [Tube Expanders & Bevelers](https://insitools.com/product/tube-expanders-bevelers.html)

## Flange Facers
Portable flange facing machines re-machine flange sealing faces, gasket grooves and heat-exchanger faces on site, restoring a leak-free seal without removing the pipe, vessel or valve.
- [FDG1650 Flange Facing Machine](https://insitools.com/product/fdg1650-flange-facing-machine.html)
- [PFM165 Mini Flange Facer](https://insitools.com/product/pfm165-mini-flange-facer.html)
- [FF5300 Flange Facer](https://insitools.com/product/ff5300-flange-facer.html)
- [FF6300 Flange Facer](https://insitools.com/product/ff6300-flange-facer.html)
- [FF7200 Flange Facer](https://insitools.com/product/ff7200-flange-facer.html)
- [FF8200 Heavy Flange Facer](https://insitools.com/product/ff8200-heavy-flange-facer.html)

## Hydraulic Tools
High-pressure hydraulic tools – power units, torque wrenches, pumps and cylinders – provide controlled force for bolting, lifting and maintenance work in the field.
- [LP3 Series Torque Wrench Pump](https://insitools.com/product/lp3-series-torque-wrench-pump.html)
- [HPU700-H High Flow Electric Hydraulic Power Unit](https://insitools.com/product/hpu700-h-high-flow-electric-hydraulic-power-unit.html)
- [Hydraulic Torque Wrenches](https://insitools.com/product/hydraulic-torque-wrenches.html)
